The brambles keep scratching my thighs. I wish I had long pants.
We want to liberate Pokemon from their trainers!
That's easier said than done, some trainers are mean!
We used to have more followers, but we split apart after N left.
Now there are two groups of Team Plasma, one who wants to steal and one who wants to make amends and return stolen Pokemon.
But WE have the cooler outfits!
With my equipment, I'm protected from electric shock!
That means that I can pet wild Pikachu without fear.
I was supposed to fix a utility pole, but I can't find it anywhere.
I'm starting to think I'm getting hazed.
There's going to be a power outage tomorrow.
Don't panic; it's just maintenance.
No, I'm not angry at you. I always make that face.
That's my normal face! My neutral face. You got a problem with that?
Miltank got a thousand uses, kiddo.
Thaaah's why y'all need we guys 'round. Without us, where y'all gonna get yer milk 'n' leather, hm?
Y'all city folks like tans, do ya?
Come work with me on th' ranch, junior. Gon' give ya some colors!
It's hard work bein' a Rancher. Mah back's killin' me.
Ah just wanna sit in mah rockin' chair for a few hours, an' rest.
Y'all should go to the countryside some time.
Breathe some good countryside air.
When I grow up, I'm gonna be a Pokémon Master. And a fireman!
I sure wish I had a Pokémon like you do!
Wow, did you get your Pokémon at a shop, or did you catch them for real?
I made a Poké Ball outta paper and some glue. It doesn't work much though.
My dad is a famous Pokémon catcher!
Well, actually, he caught a Caterpie in the garden but he let it go...
Watch me catch Pokémon with a net! I nearly caught a Weedle the other day!
One day I'm gonna catch them all!
Hey, are all those Pokémon yours? Make sure you look after them well!
I'll be back to check that you have cared for your Pokémon properly!
Have you seen any sign of Team Rocket? I've heard a rumor they were seen nearby.
You saw Team Rocket in the next town? Ok, thanks! I'm on it!
Watch out for Pokémon thieves. There have been reports of that in this area lately.
You're not one of Pokémon thieves, now are you?
I love my job! I get to look for troublemakers and put things right!
Pokémon thieves, swindlers, all kinds of crooks! Watch out for Officer Jenny!
What makes Palkia part water anyway?
Like, what part of the distorter of space says water type?
Dialga and Palkia are pretty intimidating, but have you SEEN Giratina?
That thing is the ruler of the Distortion World, a literal demon!
And its Origin Form? The fuel of nightmares!
We want to...wait, what's our motive again?
I think it's something to do with space...maybe Pluto?
Yeah, that's it! We want Pluto to be a planet again!
Do you want to find out what 'or else' means?
So, have you brought me that Pikachu yet? It's been eight generations!
My Persian went through five of its nine lives waiting!
Running a evil corporation AND a gym is a lot of work.
Luckily, some twerp destroyed my HQ, so now I can focus on being a better battler.
I used to patrol the forest, but nowadays, I'm mostly around town.
The urban jungle! It's like the jungle, but urban.
I can recognize every local plant and animal species.
Go on, quiz me!
You may not know it, but towns need Rangers too.
One neglectful gardener, and boom! You have all sorts of things roaming in the neighborhood!
Only YOU can prevent forest fires!
Be responsible with your Fire-type Pokémon, and don't use Ember in the underbrush.
Team Rocket, blasting off at the speed of light!
Yes, the speed of light...Don't question it.
We disown those two clowns and the Meowth.
They're more of a Rainbow Rocket.
Give me your Pokemon, otherwise I'll have to use my level 12 Zubat!
Do you think other teams make fun of us?
At least we're better than Team Skull, right?
I'm the Team Skull boss, and I've never been scared of nothing or nobody.
Heck, I make people scared of ME!
Hey kid, trying to pick a fight with Guzma?
That's what I thought, numskull!
Technological advances are fascinating! Sometimes I talk my wife's ear off.
...Yes, my wife! Why are people always surprised by that?
I'm currently researching deviated epidermal albinism in Pokémon!
Or "Shinies" for the layman.
This lab coat is not very comfy,  but what else can I wear to do research?
Shorts?
The Pokédex says Cubone's mother died - but if EVERY Cubone's mother died...
That math doesn't add up at all!
My little girl wants a Leafeon so badly. I don't have the heart to tell her a Leaf Stone won't work.
I should research why that is...
What makes Palkia part water anyway?
Like, what part of the distorter of space says water type?
Dialga and Palkia are pretty intimidating, but have you SEEN Giratina?
That thing is the ruler of the Distortion World, a literal demon!
And its Origin Form? The fuel of nightmares!
We want to...wait, what's our motive again?
I think it's something to do with space...maybe Pluto?
Yeah, that's it! We want Pluto to be a planet again!
I may be a Black Belt, but I must keep training!
Find me boards, cinderblocks, and a waterfall. Quick!
Huah! Sho! OooooooOOOOOOOOO!
Are you impressed yet? Did I strike your heart with dread?
With my level of skill, everything is a weapon.
I can fend off hordes of rabid Raticate with my little finger.
I was raised by Machoke.
If they had been Machamp, maybe I would have been even stronger.
My family had a Pokémon Center built when I was still a young man.
If you look closely, you will find our coat of arms carved somewhere on its walls.
I am a patron of the arts. As such, I sponsor Smeargle breeding.
I have seen some that could paint in five different styles from birth!
I am very late for a luncheon!
No, a luncheon is NOT an Eevee evolution. How unsophisticated of you!
My instructor says that brute strength is nothing without agility. They complement each other.
Fly like a Butterfree, sting like a Beedrill, he says.
I've practiced my flying kicks to perfection.
I can jump so far you'll swear I'll never land! Yaaaaaaa!
I like capoeira; it's like dancing and fighting at the same time.
It frees up so much space around me at parties.
I wonder if I can work at a Pokémon Center when I grow up.
What kind of school do you have to go to if you want to work there? I should ask.
I'll be going to after-school activities today.
I can't wait for class to be over!
We're learning about a distant region in geography class.
There are lots of volcanoes all over! Awesome!
My teacher's going to take us to a field trip next month!
We'll visit a Pokémon ranch. Maybe we'll see cute baby Pokémon?
Stick out your tongue and say aah.
You are looking rather pale. Do you need a tonic?
Oh my, you should get more sun. It's good for your bones, you know.
Are you my next patient? It's so busy, sigh.
I have only the tastiest of medicine. I make it myself!
I should have studied to become a Pokémon doctor. Much more interesting.
Don't forget to take your tonic twice a day. Maybe three times. Or four...
The very best tonic is laughter! Do you know any jokes?
Of course global warming is real!
What did you think, it was Groudon using its drought ability?
Blue orbs, Red orbs, whichever expands the landmasses works for me!
Pff, Archie wants there to be more ocean...
It's just a bunch of seaweed and some subpar fish Pokemon.
Not to mention that HUMANS LIVE ON LAND! We need land to live, Archie!
*Sigh* If you see him, could you knock some sense into him for me?
We're learning a lot of interesting stuff at school, but I can't wait to become a Trainer.
The next best thing is the summer activities with the Rangers!
I need to return home, or I'm going to miss "My Little Ponyta"!
And then my friends are going to spoil it before I can watch a rerun...
If I have 2000 PokéDollars and Poké Balls are worth 200 PokéDollars each, how many Poké Balls can I get?
Eleven! It was a trick question, because I also get the free Premier Ball!
Today Cody from school got his Poké Ball taken away by the teacher.
He kept playing with it and bothering everyone.
Shh! Don't scare off the fish!
Ah, Pokémon catching, are you? I prefer fish myself.
Do you know of any good lures? Apricorns don't work at all.
I like to catch them and throw them back again.
These mobs just keep coming!
Wave after wave...how many lives need to be lost for this battle to end?
I'd rather fight Pokemon over waves of skeletons and zombies!
Fight for what you believe in, otherwise you're fighting for nothing.
Though this be madness, yet there is method in't.
I love Zubat SO MUCH.
Sometimes I venture into caves just to get hundreds of little Zubat hugs!
I won a contest once.
My Pokémon are officially the cutest patootiest!
You see that pin on my jacket? It's from the official World Pokéfan Club store...
I tried making one myself but it wasn't as nice.
I'm the president of the local Pokéfan club.
You should join us. You seem to love your Pokémon.
I am so nervous, I hope I don't mess up my vows!
Today is the happiest day of my life, I can't wait to be married!
My Pokédex talks about Cubone's dead mother... that's absurd!
I bred my Cubone. Her mother is just fine!
I get to spend all day taking care of cute little baby Pokémon...
It's my dream job!
Ditto! Is that you?
Oh! Sorry... my Ditto likes to play games sometimes.
My husband uses my breeding for research he's doing on "Shiny" Pokémon.
I'm sure it's very fascinating, but sometimes he goes on...
My little girl wanted to know why her Leaf Stone wasn't working on Eevee...
I'd never thought about it before- but I'm not sure why either!?
Magma thinks they stand a chance against us!
The world is more ocean than land! Plus, we have the type advantage! We're the better team!
Groudon is cool and all, but nothing beats our Kyogre!
Our boss keeps telling us that he's going to use Kyogre to flood the land.
But where would we live?! Last time I checked, us grunts can't breath water!
I was fired out of the cannon when we ran out of cannonballs.
Have you seen my parrot?
I sat him down somewhere, and I can't remember where I put 'em.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
But I'm a pirate, so I don't know how that applys to me.
You're about to walk the plank!
Not all pirates have eye patches, peg legs, and rotten teeth.
I go to the dentist twice a year!
Hello there young Trainer!
When I was your age I had a beautiful little Bulbasaur.
Do you really think you should be hanging around with Pokémon?
I think they're scary.
Aw look, my Gastly cursed me.
I expected soul-rending agony, but it just tickles.
I can never get my Litwick to stand still around my occult circles.
They ruin all my rituals.
No...
Still not the one...
My friends don't believe I can do dark magic.
They used to not believe me, anyway. I no longer have any friends.
We used to bury our treasure under red X's, but people would keep stealing it.
We had to get crafty, so we started hiding our treasure better.
Like underneath two palm trees crossed together like an X.
Your treasures will be mine!
Taking the gold out of the sea temple be harder than opening a clam!
You got any oranges on you? My crew be getting scurvy.
The flowing time...the expanding space...
All of it will be mine someday!
If the beings of time and space are brought together, they can't be stopped!
Then I change this incomplete world to my image!
Making a new world is too troublesome, so I'm making my grunts complete this one. Adding Galactic statues, etc.
I caught a Pidgey again. I think I'm going to start a collection.
Then maybe I'll release them all at the same time, in class.
I've seen a documentary about the savanna and now I want a Shinx.
But a Ranger told me it'd be "environmentally irresponsible". That's so unfair.
My mom took me to the circus last week!
I saw two Spheal juggling a third one. I didn't know they could do that.
Hello there, would you like to buy fresh broccoli?
You don't like broccoli? Well, I've never heard that before!
Welcome to the market. Can I help you find what you are looking for?
Pokémon? No, this is a food market. I don't think you eat those, do you?
Nice day, isn't it? Would you like to buy some bananas?
I'll have you know, bananas are brain food! That's why I'm so smart!
Hurry, hurry! Bargains galore at our store today!
Too expensive? Hah! It's a bargain compared to yesterday's price!
Hello, we have some lovely sweet apples just in today.
No, you can't taste-test them first!
We're the fashionable team whose very name makes people tremble in fear!
We don't care one bit about what happens to other trainers or Pokemon.
Our fire Pokemon are lit!
Just try and put out the flames of Team Flare!
Today is a very special day for me!
I hope it doesn't rain.
Does this dress make my hips look big?
You know the saying don't stare at the sun?
Well, same goes for lighthouse lights...
Who needs a night light when you have a lanturn!
And I would have gotten away with it too, if it weren't for those meddling kids!
The air sure is salty today...
Someone must have lost a gym battle.
Hey now, no using Dig to break into people's houses, understood?
Or using Thief on other trainers for that matter. Says so right in the name!
I'm not completely fine with that business of earning money through Pokémon battles.
That sounds vaguely illegal.
Those dang criminal teams! I wish I could take them down myself.
But nooooooo, a kid steals our thunder every time. Let the police do their job!
I'm part of the K-9 section. I really like my Houndour.
Chasing burglars, sniffing out dangerous stuff, she does it all.
You know Dasher and Dancer, Prancer and Vixen. Coment and Cupid, Donner and Blitzen.
Who's Rudolph?
He had a red nose? That doesn't sounds healthy.
I don't have a toy factory, but I do have a command block.
What do you want for Christmas? I might be able to spawn it in.
Merry Christmas!
I think Mrs. Claus changed my chocolate chip cookies to raisin.
I'm putting her on the naughty list.
I have a future that I must change.
I will become unbeatable, like any other.
Truth and Ideals. Yin and Yang. Zekrom and Reshiram.
To you they may only see these two as legendarys for your collection.
However, if these two were gone, Kyurem would cover the world in ice. They keep balance in the world.
I remember the Pokemon I frist had...a Darmanitan, a Woobat, and my Zoura.
The bonds you make with these creatures are truly amazing!
And no matter how many times you start your journey, you're always making new bonds with your Pokemon!
The newest issue of Smoochum Monthly is out today!
I need it! I'd better hurry and get it before it's out of stock!
I've just won an auction for a PokéPlush bundle.
Soon my collection will be complete!
I can't wait for my kid to grow a little taller.
I've made him a Pikachu costume but it's a bit loose on him.
My wife and I love Pokémon to bits.
It annoys some people when we talk about them a lot. Feh!
Who cares that Team Aqua has the type advantage?
Groudon would beat Kyogre any day!
Let's see, a giant dinosaur, or a bloated whale...
You know what else is a whale Pokemon? Wailord. Kyogre is just a glorified Wailord!
Whereas Groudon is a cool dinosaur, and everyone loves dinosaurs!
People keep confusing us for Team Valor for some reason...
I wonder if Aqua has the same problem...
Volcanos are cool!.
Or should I say, hot? HA!
To flood the land to make more room for the ocean...
It sounded a lot cooler in my head, and it does have its flaws...but I'm still going through with it!
As the head of Team Aqua, I have dedicated myself to thwarting Magma's plans.
They want to expand the land, but everything depends on the sea, so we're doing the opposite of them!
You wouldn't understand, so stay out of our way!
It's hard working in here all day with this heat!
A Blacksmith's work never gets boring.
You never know what each day will bring!
Oh, were you waiting? Didn't see ya.
Okay, okay, hang on! What do you want to buy, anyway?
Welcome to the store. Yawn...
How should I know if we have that size in stock? Can't you make do with the smaller one?
Can I be of service? ...Sigh.
Yes, well, I'm kinda busy. Make up your mind and buy something, okay?
Yes, I know you have been waiting. We're all waiting for something!
What would I choose? Heck, I'd never shop here for a million dollars!
Hello there, are you going to buy that?
Well, don't just leave it there! Put it back on the shelf yourself!
I'm not going to talk to you! You're a stranger!
What's it like to be a stranger?
Hmmph! I've got better Pokémon in my closet! I've even got a Moltres!
So what if my Moltres is a toy one? You haven't got any Moltres!
Are you here to catch some Pokémon? Are they scary ones?
I bet I could catch a scary Pokémon if I had Mega Super Magic Poké Ball!
Are you scared of Pokémon? I'm not scared at all! Well, not much...
Some Pokémon are a BIT scary. I only like the fluffy ones.
Winter is coming...
Everyone knew what this place was, and no one told me.
No one but you.
Even the strongest blizzards start with a single snowflake.
Or a Cryogonal. That causes blizzards too...
Let the storm rage on, the cold never bothered me anyway.
This is such a quaint town. Look at those laborers, walking about their lives.
I have more important things to do, now. I'm off to buy a diamond.
I wonder where my chauffeur is. He left with the car MINUTES ago.
I cannot possibly stand around in these shoes for much longer.
Great Balls? Oh, child, you are so easily satisfied. My Poké Balls are made of solid gold.
But they get bumps very quickly, so I have to replace them often. Oh well!
I sent my grandson off to see the world with so little. He only has one Rattata.
And his blue suit. And a mere five million PokéDollars in cash. I hope he survives. Oh...
We want to liberate Pokemon from their trainers!
That's easier said than done, some trainers are mean!
We used to have more followers, but we split apart after N left.
Now there are two groups of Team Plasma, one who wants to steal and one who wants to make amends and return stolen Pokemon.
But WE have the cooler outfits!
Team Yell cheers each other on even when we know we're beat!
Especially Marnie, she's the best! We'd do anything to see her as Pokemon Champion!
We don't always yell what we say!
WHY WOULD YOU SAY SUCH A THING?!
Oops, sorry, need to remember to use my inside voice!
We always deliver the mail, rain or shine, blizzard or sandstorm!
Delivering mail is hard without Pokemon.
Especially if people live in the sky or underwater.
The hardest deliveries are at Team Magma and Team Aqua's base.
Sorry trainer, I don't have any mail for you today.
Carrier pidoves are the best!
Except if they run into higher leveled Pokemon...
Welcome to the Sandstone Cavern Resort Gym.
Our Gym Leader will make you fall!
When you think you're done, the battle will have just begun.
Welcome to the Snowflake Gym.
Our Gym Leader loves to freeze his opponents up!
Try not to fall off the snowflakes; it may hurt...

chat.win: Water outlasts everything, even you!
chat.lose: The flow of time has caught up to me, it seems...

chat.opening: You will go down!
